oneOf.description: Record only the derived observation. Smallest storage.
Record protocol banners and response headers. Default.
Record full response bodies up to the per-response cap.

NonEmpty_of_string.description:
A vector guaranteed to hold at least one element.

Used so that a `Finding` cannot be constructed without evidence. The
guarantee lives in the type system rather than in a validation pass,
because a validation pass can be forgotten.

Objective.description:
What the caller is trying to learn. Objectives are a closed set so the
planner can map each to a bounded strategy; free-text goals belong to the
agent layer, which compiles them into one of these.

oneOf.description: Which services are listening and what they are.
Re-observe a previous scan's endpoints to detect change.
Re-probe only endpoints whose prior confidence was low.
The 100 most commonly listening TCP ports, from our own dataset.
The 1000 most commonly listening TCP ports, from our own dataset.
All 65535 TCP ports. Requires a budget large enough to cover them.

anyOf.description: Explicit ports and inclusive ranges, e.g. `["22", "80", "8000-8100"]`.

ScanRequestSpec.description:
A scan request as a caller may state it.

This is every field of a scan request except the identity of the manifest
that authorizes it, which the server fills in from the document it loaded
at `manifest_path`. The budget fields are optional and default to the
manifest's own ceiling: the ceiling is a hard limit an operator already
wrote down, and the alternative -- a built-in default -- would be a number
this program invented for someone else's network.

idempotency_key.description:
Names this attempt. Repeating it with an identical plan returns the
original scan; repeating it with a different plan is refused.

max_packets.description: Hard packet ceiling. Defaults to the manifest's own ceiling.

max_packets_per_second.description: Hard packets-per-second ceiling. Defaults to the manifest's own ceiling.

max_runtime_seconds.description: Hard runtime ceiling in seconds. Defaults to the manifest's own ceiling.

ports.description: A named preset, or an explicit list of ports and inclusive ranges.

targets.description: CIDRs, single addresses, or inclusive `a.b.c.d-e.f.g.h` ranges.

description: Compute a plan and a policy decision without emitting a packet.

manifest_path.description: Filesystem path to the scope manifest authorizing this scan.
